summary: Excellent PowerShell & YAML conventions: Set-StrictMode, error handling, pinned actions (checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions. Pure-function engine design (Get-ArtifactCleanupPlan) enables testing. Clear policy model with detailed comments (ArtifactCleanup.psm1 lines 57–80). Meaningful output markers for CI parsing. Minor: DryRun switch handling in workflow (lines 76–84) slightly convoluted; Get-Prop pattern lacks inline rationale. Sorted output across multiple places justified by context. Would ship confidently.
